The image of the figure: four dark waves on a ground of 200, at 70 before a blur of sigma 0.6 and noise of sigma 4, and a dark disk of radius 6. The numbers are the result of the Sato filter from 0 to 255, as the median along the middle of each wave and the value at the middle of the disk. Each result is stretched so its strongest response is 255.
